claim_scope: classify candidate systems by representation dynamics conditioning and use
separate VLA policies video predictors simulators and learned world models
record unsupported capabilities instead of inferring them from names
keep transition evidence action intervention learned dynamics and direct policy output as separate tri-state claims
show that one current observation can alias histories with different optimal actions and retain decision regret
separate current-only state noisy history belief and perfect-history oracle values under authored cue likelihoods

data.name: official-source metadata worksheet with authored state-aliasing and noisy-history belief cases

limitations: classification is use-dependent rather than a universal ontology
supported means supported by the locked card evidence and unsupported does not prove global absence
counts describe eight authored archetypes and do not estimate prevalence in the research ecosystem
individual projects must be checked at a pinned version before runtime claims
paper and documentation metadata were summarized rather than runtime-tested
the state-aliasing and noisy-history results use two equally weighted authored contexts, one-step returns, and known cue likelihoods
the noisy Bayes calculation is not a learned or calibrated belief model, and the perfect-history oracle does not demonstrate that a sequence model can learn or generalize the required memory
